# Decision-aware cost of the gap-resolved ISC observable (generated by decision_cost.py)

CAS(12,11), THC qubitization: 158 logical qubits, 2.97e+03 Toffolis per walk step, λ' = λ + |E0 − c0| = 15.9 + 3.46 = 19.4 Ha, filter width Δ = 0.072 eV, filter degree d = (0.554 ln(1/ε) + -0.106) λ'/Δ (fitted to our filters). Coherent S1 preparation (sum of Slaters + eigenstate filter, γ² = 0.5, 3 applications) 6.6e+07, H_SO basis rotation 4.5e+03, one QPE for E(S1) at 2 mHa 1.1e+08 Toffolis. Success probability p = k_ISC/K′, K′ = (2π/ħ) α_SO² ρ_max. Confidence 0.95 per decision. MLAE constant c = 45.0 (95th percentile, from ae_demo.py).

Reference, arXiv:2512.15889 (Orig-BDP, N = 11): ISC proxy 7.96e+07 Toffolis × 483 shots = 3.8e+10 at fixed additive precision (not a decision; the proxy gives no absolute rate).
